hypotheses.statement: In Bessa's own family (3 straight longerons, 1 storey, zero pre-twist, circular section, ratio_pitch<=1.5, ratio_d in [0.004,0.073]) NO design that satisfies all feasibility criteria (coilable, mcs>=0.8, windowed mls<=2%, no ring pass-through) reaches 10x the Bessa point (sigma_peak >= 1.122 kPa/longeron), because coil-buckling winds the longerons to a tight radius so the 2% strain limit caps force at ~ pi*E*eps^4*l^2/(4*Theta^2) (<~0.3 kPa/longeron for l<=225 mm, Theta>=pi).
hypotheses.prediction: Best feasible sigma_peak in the Bessa circular box stays below 0.5 kPa/longeron (expected ~0.11-0.2), i.e. at most ~4x the Bessa point, never 10x.
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: A budgeted 3-phase zoom-BO (3 phases x 40 = 120 oracle evals, async 16-wide, Bessa circular box via bo/run_recovery_circular-style run) finds ANY feasible design with sigma_peak >= 1.122 kPa/longeron. If best feasible stays < 0.5 kPa the cap prediction survives; the test is a 3-D box so 120 evals plus Bessa's own published mapping gives adequate coverage power.

hypotheses.statement: A pre-twisted, helically-wound-longeron mast (3 longerons, polyline-approximated helices of ~1 turn, radius-preserving rather than inward-coiling) is a different mechanism from Bessa coil-buckling: compression is carried by distributed wire torsion at the mast radius (R~50 mm), so a feasible design (mcs>=0.8, windowed mls<=2%, ring_passthrough False, no longeron-longeron clearance violation) reaches sigma_peak >= 1.122 kPa/longeron. First-principles estimate: torsion-spring rate k=G d^4/(64 R^3 n) gives sigma_peak(95%) ~ 1.2 kPa/longeron already at wire d=5 mm, n=1 turn, H=100 mm, with torsional strain ~0.6% << 2%.
hypotheses.prediction: At least several feasible designs with sigma_peak between 1.2 and ~10 kPa/longeron exist (a >=10x margin is plausible), with riks mcs>=0.8 and mls <=0.02 at d~4-8 mm, twist ~0.5-1.5 turns.
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: After beam-validity prefiltering (spring index D/d>=6 and wire-length/d>=10), a budgeted search of the helical family (zoom-BO or space-filling DoE, >=60 oracle evals over twist angle, ratio_d, ratio_pitch, n_storeys fixed) finds NO feasible design with sigma_peak >= 1.122 kPa/longeron while the screening surrogate for sigma_peak has cross-validated R2>0.5 (so the search had power); or every high-sigma design violates ring-passthrough/self-clearance/2% strain.

hypotheses.statement: A mirror-symmetric (palindromic-twist, zero net twist, left-then-right-handed halves) helical mast does not sway sideways under the circular-identical free top boundary condition, whereas the single-handed one-turn helix does (68 mm lateral top shift by mcs 0.39 in D003).
hypotheses.prediction: P7 reaches mcs>=0.8 with converged/decided result, top lateral shift < 25 mm, finite sigma_peak.
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: Palindromic probe P7 (ratio_pitch 1.0, d=5 mm, phi=(pi/2,pi,pi/2,0), free top BC) is truncated by lateral sway (top-ring lateral shift > R1/2 = 25 mm, or Riks non-convergence / timeout) before reaching mcs 0.8 -> prediction contradicted. Surviving requires P7 to reach mcs>=0.8 with a finite windowed sigma_peak. (One probe point: adequacy is limited to this geometry; a contradiction here indicts only this parameter set unless P2/P3 also fail.)

hypotheses.statement: A conical (frustum) helical-longeron mast, whose three strands spiral inward as radius shrinks with height, nests radially instead of stacking when compressed; this removes the mid-turn strand stacking that makes the cylindrical helix self-touch at mcs 0.49 (D006), so feasible designs (mcs>=0.8, mls<=2%, self-contact-free, no ring pass-through) with sigma_peak >= 1.122 kPa/longeron exist.
hypotheses.prediction: At least one feasible design with sigma_peak between 1.2 and ~10 kPa/longeron, mcs>=0.8, mls<=0.02, min clearance >0 at d~4-7 mm, rr_top ~0.4-0.7.
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: In a 6-D family (ratio_pitch, ratio_d, rr_top, total twist Phi, twist-distribution exponent g, radius-profile exponent h; rigid joints, platen top), a prefiltered Sobol DoE of >=32 points followed by constrained-EI zoom-BO of >=80 further evals (>=110 total) finds NO feasible design with sigma_peak >= 1.122, while a GP surrogate of min_clearance_over_window or riks_strain on the evaluated set reaches cross-validated R2 > 0.5 (the search then had power). A feasible design below target, or only truncated/non-converged rows, counts as 'not found'.

hypotheses.statement: A two-storey COUNTER-CHIRAL conical-helical mast (lower storey right-handed, upper storey its mirror image about a floating rigid mid ring; net top-ring twist zero by symmetry) keeps sigma_peak>=1.122 kPa/longeron, mcs>=0.8, mls<=2% when the top ring's rotation is locked by platen friction (top_bc 'locked': u1=u2=ur1=ur2=ur3=0), whereas the best single-handed conical helix violates the 2% strain limit under that locked BC.
hypotheses.prediction: Single-handed best under 'locked': windowed mcs<0.8 or mls>2% (rotation-locked helix is ~25x stiffer in strain terms, per the D009 W1 double-helix result k0=42 vs 1.15 kPa/unit mcs). Counter-chiral under 'locked': feasible with sigma_peak in ~1.2-5 kPa and top ur3 ~0 over the window.
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: (a) Under top_bc='locked' the best counter-chiral design found by a >=60-eval zoom-BO in the 6-D mirror family has NO feasible design with sigma_peak>=1.122, OR (b) the best single-handed design of D012 stays feasible (windowed mcs>=0.8, mls<=0.02) with sigma_peak>=1.122 under the 'locked' BC, which removes the need for counter-chirality.

hypotheses.statement: The D012 optimum is limited by the BO box edges (ratio_pitch 0.80, Phi ~7 rad, d~3.3 mm, rr_top ~0.39), so widening the box (ratio_pitch down to 0.5, Phi up to 11 rad, rr_top down to 0.25) yields a feasible design with sigma_peak >= 1.5 kPa/longeron (>=1.34x target), a margin that would survive a ~25% lower printed shear modulus (G=954 vs 1287 MPa).
hypotheses.prediction: Best feasible sigma_peak in the widened box >= 1.5 kPa/longeron with windowed mcs >= 0.8 and clearance margin >= 0.5 mm.
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: A budgeted existence search (warm-started CEI-BO, 36 new evals in the widened box, concurrency 6, 100 min wall cap) finds no feasible design with sigma_peak >= 1.5 kPa. Because the budget is small, such a negative is a bounded negative (INCONCLUSIVE), not a proof of absence; a feasible >=1.5 design SUPPORTS it.
